text:
# Toyota_Service_Status_Agent: where the car is, approvals, the bill and collection, for a car
# that is already with a service centre or the body shop (journey 07 "Service status and
# collection", plus the body shop case N04 that the document prints under journey 05).
# Covers: E103 (P07), P05, P06, N13, N14, N17, N04
#   E103  (alias P07) "Where is my car? Is it done?": reads the status by booking number, or by
#         the plate together with the mobile number on the booking (the status service takes
#         nothing less). A car settled earlier in the call is looked up without a question. A
#         caller whose car is not known, which includes every caller whose number is not on
#         file, is asked in the order of E92: the booking number first, then the plate, then
#         the phone. Nothing shows: emails the service centre and gives the callback time that
#         request returns, as the contact centre does today.
#   P05   work waiting for approval, or extra work found: says the centre needs their OK and
#         emails the branch so the service advisor calls back. The agent never takes the approval.
#   P06   "What will I pay when I collect it?": never quotes the bill; emails the branch so the
#         service advisor calls back with the amount.
#   N13   OPEN (contact centre): the problem is back, or the bill was higher than quoted: sent to
#         the service advisor with the last visit noted. The last visit is a fact read from the
#         car's record (centre, date, service advisor, booking reference); the caller is not asked
#         for it. No visit on record: a person.
#   N14   OPEN (contact centre): held waiting for parts: reads the status and the date of the
#         next update. With no date on the status the service centre is asked to call.
#   N17   OPEN (contact centre): someone else collects, or after-hours collection: a person, until
#         the collection rules exist in the approved content.
#   N04   OPEN (Aftersales workshop): body shop. Existing case: the status if there is one, and
#         the tracking portal as a link sent by text message once the caller says yes.
#         New case or callback: a person.
# Shape: one step understands the need; the car is found by the first key that works (the
# lookup ladder of section 3); one status lookup decides the outcome (the ON_RESULT table in
# lookup_status); then either the status is read out or one request is sent to the service
# centre or service advisor and the caller hears when to expect the call. Every finished task
# ends with the shared line "Is there anything else I can help you with?" (close_turn). What
# depends on the status or on a time is worded in the caller's language by a reasoning step
# and said by a fixed step (say_spoken_line), so the closing line always comes last.
# Nothing personal is said to a caller who cannot be tied to the car: a status is read only
# after the booking number, or the plate with the mobile number on the booking, has matched.
# Open cases are switched by environment flags; an unset flag gives the interim behaviour:
#   TOYOTA_STATUS_REPEAT_ISSUE_TO_ADVISOR_ENABLED  default true   N13  off: a person
#   TOYOTA_STATUS_PARTS_HOLD_ENABLED               default true   N14  off: read like any status (E103)
#   TOYOTA_STATUS_COLLECTION_RULES_ENABLED         default false  N17  off: a person
#   TOYOTA_STATUS_BODYSHOP_EXISTING_ENABLED        default true   N04  off: a person
# Leaves to a person with one of these handover_reason codes: body_shop_new_case,
# collection_rules, repeat_problem, bill_higher_than_quoted (the need itself is a person's),
# caller_asked, manager_requested (the caller asked for one), body_shop_case,
# owner_not_verified, car_reference_not_captured, need_not_understood, no_last_visit_on_record,
# service_centre_not_known, no_callback_number, team_request_not_sent,
# collection_rules_not_answered, status_system_down.
# Both escapes hand off in the step that raises the flag (hand_to_person, leave_for_safety).
AGENT: Toyota_Service_Status_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Tells a caller where their car is in the workshop or body shop and whether it is ready, and arranges the service centre or service advisor call back for approvals, the final bill, a missing status, a problem that came back or a bill that was higher than quoted"

GOAL: |
  Tell a caller where their car is in the workshop or body shop and whether it is ready,
  from the live status. When the centre needs their approval, when they ask what they will
  pay, when no status shows, when a problem has come back or a bill was higher than quoted,
  arrange for the service centre or the service advisor to call them back and say when to
  expect the call. Pass a new body shop case, and anything the status and the approved
  content cannot answer, to a person.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, speaking with a customer
  whose car is with a service centre. Calm, clear and honest about what you can see. You say
  what the status shows and no more, and the caller always knows who will call them back.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Service status, approvals, the bill and collection only. Do not book, change or cancel a service, give a price, answer warranty or product questions or open a body shop case: hand anything else back."
  - "Never quote, estimate or confirm the final bill or any amount to pay. Only the service advisor gives the amount."
  - "Never take the caller's approval for extra work and never say that work is approved. Only the service advisor takes it."
  - "Never say or guess when the car will be ready or how long the work takes. The only date you may give is the date of the next update, when the status has one."
  - "Never read out service history or invoices, and never say what the workshop found."
  - "Never give a status or any car detail to someone calling for the owner who has not been verified."
  - "Never give a status or any car detail to a caller who has not been tied to the car: by its booking number, or by its plate together with the mobile number on the booking. Knowing a plate alone is not enough."
  - "Never promise a call back unless the request to the team has been sent, and never say a message was sent unless it was sent."
  - "Talk only about the car this call is about. Never mention the caller's profile, other cars or other bookings."
  - "Never give insurance, registration or legal advice, also for accident repairs."
  - "Do not greet and do not replay a welcome. Do not ask whether there is anything else yourself: a fixed closing step says that line once, when the task is done."

LANGUAGE: "en"

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow is made of
# many small fixed steps (a long call with a change of mind enters more than a hundred of
# them) and one guide quotes a default of 100.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.1
  max_reasoning_iterations: 4
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

# No CONVERSATION section: the toyota_voice profile owns tone, the two-sentence limit, the
# language policy, interruptions and the silence ladder (E19) for every agent.
# The runtime plays the filler while a tool or a hand-over runs, so no step speaks a hold line.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

MEMORY:
  session:
    # Shared session contract, passed in by the supervisor. READONLY: the model cannot rewrite
    # who is calling or how far they were verified. identity_status can be "unknown" here: the
    # calling number is not on file and nobody has been asked anything.
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_model
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # The car this call is about. READONLY: a plate confirmed earlier in the call cannot be
    # swapped by the model; a plate confirmed in ask_reference arrives through confirmed_plate.
    # Flow steps put the earlier car aside when the caller means a different car (drop_known_car).
    - NAME: plate_number
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # Written by the model only in ask_reference, after the caller confirmed the read-back, and
    # by the flow from a booking that belongs to the identified caller (use_owner_reference).
    - NAME: booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    # Escapes. The model may raise safety_flag and may record that the caller asked for a
    # person (person_request: caller_asked or manager_requested). Only flow steps raise
    # needs_person, after they have set the reason and the summary.
    - NAME: safety_flag
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: person_request
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: needs_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_queue
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # Written by the model in the steps that listen to the caller or read approved content.
    # The notes start empty instead of absent: they are quoted in every request and
    # hand-over summary, and an absent value would leave its placeholder unresolved there.
    - NAME: status_need
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: caller_request_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
    # en or ar: the language the caller is speaking, for the call back and the text message.
    - NAME: call_language
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
    # True when the caller means a different car from the one settled earlier in the call.
    - NAME: different_car
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: confirmed_plate
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: reference_rejected
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: need_changed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
    # E92 "then plate and phone": the mobile number on the booking, as the caller gave it and
    # confirmed it (ask_booking_mobile). mobile_unknown: the caller cannot give one.
    - NAME: booking_mobile
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: mobile_unknown
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
    # OPEN N04: the caller's answer to the offer of the tracking link (yes or no), and another
    # number for it when they gave one.
    - NAME: link_choice
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: link_mobile
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    - NAME: collection_note
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
    # The sentence a reasoning step worded for the caller, in the caller's language. It is said
    # by say_spoken_line, a fixed step, so that the closing line always comes after it.
    - NAME: spoken_line
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
    # Written by flow steps only.
    - NAME: last_visit_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reference_tries
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: need_changes
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # The lookup ladder (section 3): what has been tried so far in this activation.
    - NAME: car_dropped
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_only
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: reference_missed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lookup_mobile
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: phone_tried
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: contact_tried
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: said_mobile_tried
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: mobile_asked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_searched
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_total
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_owner_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_found_reference
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: owner_reference_used
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # Published by get_service_status. Declared here so that it starts empty on every activation.
    - NAME: status_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # The centre, the stage and the two flags are shown to the steps that speak, so they start
    # empty or false instead of absent: a step then sees "nothing written" where the status
    # gave nothing. status_next_update is only shown when the status carried a date.
    - NAME: status_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: status_stage
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: status_stage_label
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: status_next_update
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: status_ready
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: status_known
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # N13: the last visit as the car's record shows it. Never read out: it goes into the
    # request to the service advisor, and its centre is the centre the request goes to.
    - NAME: last_visit_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_visit_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_visit_date
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_visit_advisor
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_visit_reference
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: first_booking
      TYPE: object
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_team
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_type
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_reason
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_language
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "en"
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "unknown"
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: callback_number
      TYPE: string
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: callback_expected
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: callback_expected_by
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # Published by send_team_request. Declared here so that it starts false on every activation.
    - NAME: team_request_sent
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # OPEN N04: the number the tracking link goes to, and its last three digits as they are spoken.
    - NAME: link_number
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: message_spoken_digits
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: link_last_digits
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    # OPEN N17: what the search of the approved content returned, for note_collection_rules.
    - NAME: collection_results
      TYPE: array
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true

TOOLS:
  get_service_status(booking_reference?: string, plate_number?: string, mobile_number?: string) -> {found: boolean, stage: string, stage_label: string, awaiting_customer_approval: boolean, waiting_for_parts: boolean, ready_for_collection: boolean, next_update_date: string, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, case_type: string}
    description: "Read where a car is in the workshop or body shop by booking number, or by plate together with the mobile number on the booking. When both a booking number and a plate are given, the booking number is used. Never returns or quotes the bill. stage is one of in_progress, awaiting_approval, waiting_for_parts, ready_for_collection, per current policy, and stage_label says the same in words. case_type is service or body_shop. An unknown booking or car returns found false, not an error. When found is false, email the service centre and give a callback time."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      booking_reference:
        description: "Booking or service order number from the confirmation SMS"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car when the caller has no booking number. Give mobile_number with it"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number on the booking, E.164. Needed with the plate when there is no booking number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.booking_reference != "" || params.plate_number != ""
          - params.booking_reference != "" || params.mobile_number != ""
        on_fail: block("A booking number, or the plate with the mobile number on the booking, is needed to read the status.")
    on_result:
      set:
        status_found: result.found
        status_centre_id: result.centre_id

  find_service_bookings(customer_id?: string, plate_number?: string, mobile_number?: string, booking_reference?: string) -> {total: number, bookings: {booking_reference: string, plate_number: string, vehicle_model: string, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, minutes_until_start: number, can_change: boolean, service_code: string, service_label: string, extra_jobs: string[], notes: string, current_km: number, preferred_advisor: string, channel: string, status: string, customer_name: string, belongs_to_customer_id: string, booked_by_name: string, contact_name: string, contact_mobile: string, is_recall: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find service bookings from every channel by booking reference, plate, mobile or customer. Returns bookings from the start of today, including a booking for a car that is in the workshop today and missed ones. status is one of confirmed (still to come), in_workshop (the car is at the centre today), missed (the time passed and the car did not come). Cancelled bookings, and bookings whose car has been collected, are not returned. All filters given must match; for a duplicate check pass the plate only. Use before booking to prevent a duplicate, before retrying a failed booking, and to find the booking a caller wants to confirm, change or cancel. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. minutes_until_start counts from now and is negative once the time has passed. can_change is true while the booking can still be changed or cancelled, per current policy. channel is one of phone, whatsapp, website, branch. customer_name and belongs_to_customer_id say whose booking it is; booked_by_name is the person who made it for them, or empty."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      customer_id:
        description: "Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car, as confirmed with the caller"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number on the booking, E.164"
      booking_reference:
        description: "Booking reference from the confirmation SMS: the DBM or service order number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.customer_id != "" || params.plate_number != "" || params.mobile_number != "" || params.booking_reference != ""
        on_fail: block("A booking reference, a plate, a mobile number or a customer is needed to find a booking.")
    on_result:
      set:
        existing_booking_count: result.total
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, bookings[].booking_reference, bookings[].plate_number, bookings[].vehicle_model, bookings[].centre_id, bookings[].centre_name, bookings[].start_time, bookings[].start_label, bookings[].minutes_until_start, bookings[].can_change, bookings[].service_code, bookings[].service_label, bookings[].extra_jobs, bookings[].preferred_advisor, bookings[].status, bookings[].booked_by_name, bookings[].is_recall, bookings[].pickup_dropoff]

  get_last_service_visit(plate_number?: string, vehicle_id?: string) -> {found: boolean, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, visit_date: string, service_advisor_name: string, booking_reference: string}
    description: "Get the last service visit of a car: the centre, the date, the service advisor and the booking reference. Use it to note the last visit on a request to the service advisor and to give that request a centre. Give the plate or the vehicle_id. It is the only part of the service history a tool returns. When the car is unknown or has no visit on record, found is false."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate as confirmed with the caller: emirate, code and number, for example Dubai A 12345"
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle, when the car is on file"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.plate_number != "" || params.vehicle_id != ""
        on_fail: block("A plate or a vehicle identifier is needed to read the last visit.")

  send_team_request(team: string, request_type: string, summary: string, customer_mobile: string, centre_id?: string, customer_name?: string, plate_number?: string, booking_reference?: string, lead_id?: string, callback_requested?: boolean, language?: string, location?: string) -> {sent: boolean, request_id: string, expected_response: string, expected_by: string}
    description: "Email a request to an internal team so they call the customer back, as the contact centre does today. Team is one of service_centre, service_advisor, showroom_manager, sales_team (unanswered sales questions), sales_after_purchase (delivery, plates, invoice, refund), auto_center_imports, parts, recall, connected_app_support, roadside, complaints, internal_language_callback, summit_stand. centre_id is required for service_centre, service_advisor and showroom_manager. expected_response says in words when the customer can expect a response, so it can be said on the call; expected_by is that time as a date-time, ISO 8601 with +04:00, and is empty when it is not known. request_id is the id that get_open_requests returns for a later chase."
    auth_profile: "toyota_notify_api"
    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      team:
        description: "Receiving team, from the list in the description"
      request_type:
        description: "One code from this closed list. Booking: no_slot_callback, same_day_booking, same_day_no_slot, same_day_walk_in, limo_booking, customer_running_late. Price: price_callback, price_enquiry_not_booked, extra_work_price_callback. Car in the workshop: approval_needed, final_bill, status_missing, parts_update, repeat_problem, bill_higher_than_quoted. Recall and warranty: recall_enquiry, safety_recall, recall_cancelled, warranty_enquiry. Other service: imported_car, parts_enquiry, connected_app_help, roadside_recovery. Sales: sales_question, follow_up_chase, delivery_enquiry, plates_enquiry, invoice_enquiry, refund_enquiry, sales_complaint, summit_test_drive. Language: hindi_urdu_callback"
      summary:
        description: "What the customer needs and what was already done on the call, in two or three sentences"
      customer_mobile:
        description: "Number to call the customer back on, E.164"
      centre_id:
        description: "Service centre or showroom the request is for: a centre_id from find_service_centres or a showroom_id from find_showrooms. Required for service_centre, service_advisor and showroom_manager"
      customer_name:
        description: "Customer's name, when known"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car concerned"
      booking_reference:
        description: "Related booking reference"
      lead_id:
        description: "Related sales lead from find_open_leads, for a request about an existing enquiry"
      callback_requested:
        description: "True when the customer expects a call back"
      language:
        description: "Language to call the customer back in: en, ar, hi or ur. Needed for internal_language_callback"
      location:
        description: "Where the car is, as the caller described it. Used for the roadside team"
    on_result:
      set:
        team_request_sent: result.sent
        team_request_id: result.request_id

  send_customer_message(mobile_number: string, template: string, channel?: string, reference?: string, reference_type?: string, language?: string) -> {sent: boolean, channel_used: string, message_id: string}
    description: "Send one templated message to the customer by SMS or WhatsApp. Templates: service_booking_confirmation (link to add to calendar, reschedule, cancel or track), service_booking_cancellation (confirms that the booking is cancelled), service_tracking_link (link to follow a car in the workshop), body_shop_tracking_link (link to the body shop tracking portal), test_drive_details (day, time, showroom map link, what to bring, confirmed or waiting for the showroom), location_and_hours, complaint_ticket, survey_invite. This is the only sender: the booking, sales and complaints systems send no message for records the AI agent creates. Always confirm the last digits of the number first. Can be sent again when the caller says it did not arrive. channel_used is sms or whatsapp."
    auth_profile: "toyota_notify_api"
    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number that receives the message, E.164"
      template:
        description: "Template name from the list in the description"
      channel:
        description: "sms or whatsapp. Leave empty to use the default configured in the notify service. The service does not fall back by itself: when a whatsapp send returns sent false, send once more with sms"
      reference:
        description: "Identifier the template is filled from: a booking reference, a test-drive reference, a complaint ticket number, a centre_id or a showroom_id"
      reference_type:
        description: "What the reference is: one of service_centre, showroom, booking, complaint. Needed for location_and_hours, which takes a service centre or a showroom"
      language:
        description: "en or ar, matching the language of the call"
    on_result:
      set:
        message_sent: result.sent

  search_toyota_knowledge(query: string) -> {results: object[]}
    description: "Search the approved Toyota content: models (specifications, trims, colours, starting prices), locations (service centre and showroom addresses, hours, phone numbers, Friday, Ramadan and holiday hours), services (what each service includes, express, key drop, shuttle, pick-up and drop-off, recovery prices), policies (service contracts, refunds and transfers, warranty, owner change, replacement car, collection) and contacts (numbers for other Al-Futtaim brands and teams, connected app support). Answer only from what is returned. When nothing relevant is returned, say you do not have that information."
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      query:
        description: "The caller's question rewritten as a short search query, including the model, centre or topic"

CONSTRAINTS:
  always:
    # Never read out details before confirming who is calling: second lock behind check_owner_verified.
    - REQUIRE identity_status != "third_party" BEFORE calling get_service_status
      WHEN: identity_status IS SET
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: why_owner_not_verified
    # The same lock on the two other lookups that read a car's record. The flow reaches them
    # only after check_owner_verified; the lock also holds if a reasoning step were to call them.
    - REQUIRE identity_status != "third_party" BEFORE calling find_service_bookings
      WHEN: identity_status IS SET
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: why_owner_not_verified
    - REQUIRE identity_status != "third_party" BEFORE calling get_last_service_visit
      WHEN: identity_status IS SET
      ON_FAIL:

    - REQUIRE link_choice == "yes" BEFORE calling send_customer_message

  steps:
